name: Dragonmaw Gates
summary: At the Dragonmaw Gates, heavy fortifications bar the road climbing from the eastern Wetlands. They guard the ascent to Grim Batol, a mountain fortress among cursed dwarven ruins.

sections.title: Sentinels of Grim Batol
sections.body: The Dragonmaw Gates seal the winding road through rugged peaks in the eastern Wetlands. The Dragonmaw orcs held Grim Batol during the Second War, and the gates bear their name. The road remains fortified, but the climb is still dangerous. Powerful drakes haunt the pass, and grim reminders of the clan’s dark history linger in the mountains.

sections.title: A Contested Threshold
sections.body: The Dragonmaw orcs were broken and scattered after the Demon Soul was destroyed. Yet the mountain path remains dangerous. Powerful red dragons have been seen watching the winding slopes and perches around the gates. Monstrous drakes and Dragonmaw remnants still lurk in the nearby hills, while the gates bar travelers bold enough to venture into the heights.

faq.q: Where do the Dragonmaw Gates lead?
faq.answer: The gates seal the winding mountain path east from the Wetlands, leading into Grim Batol and the surrounding heights.

faq.q: Why are they called the Dragonmaw Gates?
faq.answer: The gates take their name from the Dragonmaw orcs, who occupied Grim Batol during the Second War and used foul sorcery to enslave red dragons.

faq.q: Can travelers pass through the gates?
faq.answer: The massive gates are firmly shut and heavily defended, barring normal passage into the high mountains.

faq.q: Who guards the road around the gates?
faq.answer: Fierce red dragonspawn and drakes haunt the road and nearby passes. Scattered orcs and other dark threats cling to the mountain slopes.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you see the gates as the sealed threshold to Grim Batol, your people’s ancestral home. Dwarves abandoned it after the War of the Three Hammers, and the Dragonmaw orcs later desecrated it.
As an Alliance member, you watch the gates warily. Anything emerging from the high road threatens the stability of the entire Wetlands.
